newsitem.title: USA: BCAM says to buy Drew Shoe for $4.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: BCAM says to buy Drew Shoe for $4.6 mln.

text.p: BCAM International Inc said Thursday it agreed to acquire Drew Shoe Corp, a 125-year-old designer, manufacturer and distributor of medical footwear and orthotic products, for $4.6 million.
BCAM's acquisition of Drew Shoe and related financing are expected to be completed within the next 45 days, BCAM said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Drew will be retaining its current management team and workforce. Drew's facilities include a 108,000-square-foot plant, located on 11 acres in Lancaster, Ohio.
